arxiv-2012-09156.title: Learning Accurate Long-term Dynamics for Model-based Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2012-09156.creator: Nathan Lambert, Albert Wilcox, Howard Zhang, Kristofer S. J. Pister, Roberto Calandra
arxiv-2012-09156.description: Abstract Accurately predicting the dynamics of robotic systems is crucial for model-based control and reinforcement learning. The most common way to estimate dynamics is by fitting a one-step ahead prediction model and using it to recursively propagate the predicted state distribution over long horizons. Unfortunately, this approach is known to compound even small prediction errors, making long-term predictions inaccurate.

arxiv-2106-12932.title: Dynamic quarter-wave metasurface for efficient helicity inversion of polarization beyond the single-layer conversion limit
arxiv-2106-12932.description: Abstract Terahertz chiral sensing and polarization-multiplexing communication demand subwavelength devices that dynamically invert polarization helicity. Metasurfaces can enhance anisotropy and fine tunability at subwavelength scales for this purpose. Although metasurfaces enabling deep modulation between orthogonal polarizations have been designed, they suffer from low conversion efficiencies.

arxiv-2206-03832.title: Constructive TT-representation of the tensors given as index interaction functions with applications
arxiv-2206-03832.creator: Gleb Ryzhakov
arxiv-2206-03832.description: Abstract This paper presents a method to build explicit tensor-train (TT) representations. We show that a wide class of tensors can be explicitly represented with sparse TT-cores, obtaining, in many cases, optimal TT-ranks. Numerical experiments show that our method outperforms the existing ones in several practical applications, including game theory problems.

arxiv-2507-09638.title: Can Group Relative Policy Optimization Improve Thai Legal Reasoning and Question Answering?
arxiv-2507-09638.creator: Pawitsapak Akarajaradwong, Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot, Pirat Pothavorn, Attapol Thamrongrattanarit-Rutherford, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich, Sarana Nutanong
arxiv-2507-09638.description: Abstract The Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems’ performance on Thai legal question answering is still limited, especially for questions requiring extensive, complex legal reasoning. To address these limitations, we introduce an approach aligning LLMs toward improved law citation accuracy and better response quality using Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

arxiv-2507-15640.title: Data Mixing Agent: Learning to Re-weight Domains for Continual Pre-training
arxiv-2507-15640.creator: Kailai Yang, Xiao Liu, Yeyun Gong, Peng Cheng, Mao Yang
arxiv-2507-15640.description: Abstract Continual pre-training on small-scale task-specific data is an effective method for improving large language models in new target fields, yet it risks catastrophic forgetting of their original capabilities. A common solution is to re-weight training data mixtures from source and target fields on a domain space to achieve balanced performance.

arxiv-2602-15563.title: 1-Bit Wonder: Improving QAT Performance in the Low-Bit Regime through K-Means Quantization
arxiv-2602-15563.creator: Sohir Maskey, Constantin Eichenberg, Johannes Messner, Douglas Orr
arxiv-2602-15563.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Sohir Maskey, Constantin Eichenberg, Johannes Messner, Douglas Orr. Quantization-aware training (QAT) is an effective method to drastically reduce the memory footprint of LLMs while keeping performance degradation at an acceptable level. However, the optimal choice of quantization format and bit-width presents a challenge in practice. The full design space of quantization is not fully explored in the context of QAT, and the precise trade-off between quantization and downstream performance is poorly understood, as comparisons often rely solely on perplexity-based evaluations.
